character: Purpose-built circuit blending characteristics of famous corners worldwide — a steep uphill first corner, a flowing esses section inspired by Silverstone, and a long back straight into a hairpin.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Brake hard on the blind uphill approach, commit to the apex without full visibility of the exit
corners.trap: Misjudging the uphill braking distance and running wide

corners.name: Esses (Turns 2-9)
corners.technique: Rhythm and smooth inputs through the direction changes, carry maximum speed
corners.trap: Over-driving any single apex disrupts the whole sequence

corners.name: Turn 11
corners.type: heavy-braking corner onto the back straight
corners.technique: Prioritise a clean exit to maximise speed down the following long straight
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time over the entire back straight

corners.name: Turn 12
corners.type: tight hairpin at the end of the back straight
corners.technique: Hard braking from top speed, late apex, patient throttle on exit
corners.trap: Locking the front from the high braking speed

corners.name: Turn 15-18
corners.technique: Patient, precise inputs through the tightening radius
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed into the sequence and running out of track

corners.name: Turn 19-20
corners.type: final corners onto the pit straight
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical for the run to the line
corners.trap: Poor exit here costs time down the entire pit straight
